author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮನುಜತ್ವವುಜ್ಜಗಿಸೆ ದೇವತ್ವವೊಲಿಯುವುದು
ಕನಲಿಸಿರೆ ಜೀವಿಗಳ ದಾನವನೆ ನೀನು
ದನುಜ ಮಾನವಗಿಹುದು ಒಂದುವರ್ಣದ ಭೇದ
ಮನದುಲಿಯ ಅರಿತುನಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When humanity shines, divinity is drawn to you;
if you torment living beings, you are a demon;
between dānava and mānava there is the difference of one letter;
know the voice of your mind and walk by it, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Real humanity draws the divine near; cruelty makes a demon of us. In Kannada the words for demon (danuja) and human (manuja) differ by one letter, and so does the line between them in life.
